definitionZh: 数学深度属性描述数学公式每个要素的深度概念,即该公式的顶级容器。 用于在字体大小: 应用数学时, 缩放元素字体大小的计算值 。
sourceDefinition: The math-depth property describes a notion of depth for each element of a mathematical formula, with respect to the top-level container of that formula. This is used to scale the computed value of the font-size of elements when font-size: math is applied.
